title: Defers inside hot loops
summary: Using defer inside high-iteration loops where immediate cleanup is possible.
rationale: Defer is convenient, but repeated defers in loops can add overhead and delay resource release.

detection.notes: Detect defer inside loops, especially file, lock, or response-body cleanup.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Move loop body into a helper function or close/unlock explicitly at the end of each iteration.
remediation.tradeoffs: Explicit cleanup is easier to get wrong; keep helper functions small.
